title: Ordinary scalar change through canonical locally closed extension
statement: Let c:A -> B be a morphism of commutative condensed ring objects [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. For any immersion a:S -> X into a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-closed-immersion], and any internal A_S-module M [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], the canonical locally closed extension of its ordinary scalar extension B_S tensor_A_S M is isomorphic, as a B_X-module, to the ordinary scalar extension of the canonical extension of M [def-sfb-locally-closed-coefficient-extension]. All coefficient rings and maps are the pulled-back ones [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. No flatness or local freeness of M or c is assumed; empty schemes and zero modules are included.

proof.text: Use the open-immersion scalar adjunction comparison supplied by [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change]. For the closed factor take its scalar/direct-image mate. Its pullback to the closed source is invertible by the closed counit and the scalar/pullback comparison, and its pullback to the complementary open has zero source and target. Scalar extension preserves zero and commutes with pullback, so this holds without flatness.

source.place: Proof (1), Ordinary scalar change through canonical locally closed extension

proof.text: Open/closed joint reflection of isomorphisms now makes the ordinary closed mate invertible. The complementary open is quasi-compact since X is Noetherian. Compose this closed isomorphism with the open scalar isomorphism for the canonical image factorization of a. Unfold the canonical closure-factorization functor once and take the inverse orientation to match the displayed objects. Zero and empty cases follow by the same zero restrictions.

theorem condensedLocallyClosedExtension_scalar
    (A B : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj A] [IsCommMonObj A] [MonObj B] [IsCommMonObj B]
    (c : A ⟶ B) [IsMonHom c]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (a : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion a]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj A S)) :
    Nonempty ((coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension B a inferInstance).obj
      ((Mod.extendScalars ((upperStarFromPoint S).map c)).obj M) ≅
        (Mod.extendScalars ((upperStarFromPoint X).map c)).obj
          ((coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension A a inferInstance).obj M))
